ai-provider-credentials.purpose: Manage the authenticated account's encrypted BYOK keys; no project/session membership is required.
ai-provider-credentials.authz: After dispatcher JWT validation, GET /auth/v1/user authenticates the end-user. Every credential read/update/delete filters user_id = that userId; inserts set it server-side. Meshy is the only catalog provider. No owner from request is trusted.

503 missing encryption key; 404 refresh with no stored secret; 429 quota denied
listCredentials converts DB error to empty rows; refresh currently ignores PATCH response status. These are source behaviors, not verified success persistence guarantees.
ai-provider-credentials.transportSemantics: Auth10s, service20s, Meshy GET /balance15s. No automatic retry. Meshy keys require msy_ prefix and20..200 chars before outbound validation; service role and ciphertext are never returned.

List/upsert/refresh responses omit apiKey and secret_ciphertext; only rounded nonnegative credits are exposed.
Ninth upsert/refresh inside the default 60s window returns 429, list/delete do not consume quota; store failure must not call Meshy.
Missing encryption key yields 503, rejected key yields 400; upsert preserves added_at and delete of absent own row succeeds.
Inject refresh persistence failure: record current ignored PATCH behavior and require explicit successor error contract; never claim key refresh was durably stored from response alone.
knownGaps: Refresh PATCH responses are ignored; list DB errors become an empty credential list. Successor failure semantics require an explicit test-backed decision, not a silent compatibility assumption.

World lore is allowed if public or creator_user_id equals project GM (project-linked) / caller (direct reference). This is not a blanket GM-only endpoint.

session-recap.purpose: Create a GM-requested player-safe recap draft from server-derived ended-session records.
session-recap.authz: Authenticated account must equal projects.gm_user_id for sessions.project_id. A project owner/member/GM label alone is not substituted for that equality. Session must be completed or cancelled.

look-reference-analysis.purpose: Analyze 1..10 user-supplied style/content images using configured vision provider; client normalizes returned profile payload.

session-media-token.purpose: Mint short-lived LiveKit room JWTs for active project members, with degraded gameplay-preserving responses.
session-media-token.authz: /auth/v1/user identity -> sessions.project_id -> project_members(status=active,user_id=caller). Actual code has no session_players fallback despite its comment. Roles gm->gamemaster and observer->viewer; unsupported role denied. Capabilities are loaded as null/empty, not trusted from client.

marketplace.behavior: Catalog methods use marketplace_items and increment_marketplace_downloads(item_id). list has type/searchQuery/minRating/maxPrice filters and downloads-desc default; featured queries rating>=3.5,downloads desc,limit6, falling back to top6 downloads. create derives author_id from auth.getUser, initializes rating/downloads0; update/delete filter id and rely on server RLS. delete catches errors and returnsfalse. incrementDownloads returnsvoid, falls back on any RPC error to read+write downloads+1 and swallows exceptions.
marketplace.security: Create author_id comes from authenticated user; update/delete ownership is not checked in this adapter and must be enforced by effective server policy. Preserve published/catalog visibility as proved by SQL, not inferred from comments. The fallback count is non-atomic and cannot guarantee one durable increment.

Search string is interpolated into PostgREST or expression; successor parser/escaping behavior must be decided and tested.
